1.text: Now king David was old N stricken in years; N dey covered him wit clothes, but he got no heat.

So his servants said 2 him, Let there be sought 4 my lord tha king a young virgin: N let her stand before tha king, N let her cherish him, N let her lie in ur bosom, dat my lord tha king may get heat.
So dey sought 4 a fair damsel throughout all tha coasts of Israel, N found Abishag a Shunammite, N brought her 2 tha king.
N tha damsel was very fair, N cherished tha king, N ministered 2 him: but tha king knew her not.
Then Adonijah tha son of Haggith exalted himself, sayin, I will be king: N he prepared him chariots N horsemen, N fifty men 2 run before him.
N his father had not displeased him at any time in sayin, Why have u done so? N he also was a very goodly man; N his mother bare him after Absalom.
N he conferred wit Joab tha son of Zeruiah, N wit Abiathar tha priest: N dey followin Adonijah helped him.
But Zadok tha priest, N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada, N Nathan tha prophet, N Shimei, N Rei, N tha mighty men which belonged 2 David, were not wit Adonijah.
N Adonijah killed sheep N oxen N fat cattle by tha stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, N called all his brothers tha king’s sons, N all tha men of Judah tha king’s servants:
But Nathan tha prophet, N Benaiah, N tha mighty men, N Solomon his brother, he called not.
So Nathan spoke 2 Bath-sheba tha mother of Solomon, sayin, have u not heard dat Adonijah tha son of Haggith does reign, N David our lord knows it not?
Now therefore come, let me, I pray u, give u counsel, dat u may save ur own life, N tha life of ur son Solomon.

Go N get u in 2 king David, N say 2 him, did not u, my lord, O king, swear 2 thine handmaid, sayin, Assuredly Solomon ur son shall reign after me, N he shall sit upon my throne? why then does Adonijah reign?
Look, while u yet talkest there wit tha king, I also will come in after u, N confirm ur words.
N Bath-sheba went in 2 tha king in2 tha chamber: N tha king was very old; N Abishag tha Shunammite ministered 2 tha king.
N Bath-sheba bowed, N did obeisance 2 tha king. N tha king said, What would u?
N she said 2 him, My lord, u swarest by tha LORD ur God 2 thine handmaid, sayin, Assuredly Solomon ur son shall reign after me, N he shall sit upon my throne.
N now, look, Adonijah reigns; N now, my lord tha king, u know it not:
N he has killed oxen N fat cattle N sheep in abundance, N has called all tha sons of tha king, N Abiathar tha priest, N Joab tha captain of tha host: but Solomon ur servant has he not called.
N u, my lord, O king, tha eyes of all Israel r upon u, dat u should tell ’em who shall sit on tha throne of my lord tha king after him.
Otherwise it will happen, when my lord tha king shall sleep wit his fathers, dat I N my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
N, look, while she yet talked wit tha king, Nathan tha prophet also came in.
N dey told tha king, sayin, look Nathan tha prophet. N when he was come in before tha king, he bowed himself before tha king wit his face 2 tha ground.
N Nathan said, My lord, O king, have u said, Adonijah shall reign after me, N he shall sit upon my throne?

4 he is gone down dis day, N has killed oxen N fat cattle N sheep in abundance, N has called all tha king’s sons, N tha captains of tha host, N Abiathar tha priest; N, look, dey eat N drink before him, N say, God save king Adonijah.
But me, even me ur servant, N Zadok tha priest, N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada, N ur servant Solomon, has he not called.
Is dis thing done by my lord tha king, N u have not showed it 2 ur servant, who should sit on tha throne of my lord tha king after him?
Then king David answered, Call me Bath-sheba. N she came in2 tha king’s presence, N stood before tha king.
N tha king sware, N said, As tha LORD lives, dat has redeemed my soul out of all distress,
Even as I sware 2 u by tha LORD God of Israel, sayin, Assuredly Solomon ur son shall reign after me, N he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do dis day.
Then Bath-sheba bowed wit her face 2 tha earth, N did reverence 2 tha king, N said, Let my lord king David live 4 ever.
N king David said, Call me Zadok tha priest, N Nathan tha prophet, N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada. N dey came before tha king.
Tha king also said 2 ’em, Take wit u tha servants of ur lord, N cause Solomon my son 2 ride upon my own mule, N bring him down 2 Gihon:
N let Zadok tha priest N Nathan tha prophet anoint him there king over Israel: N blow y’all wit tha trumpet, N say, God save king Solomon.
Then y’all shall come up after him, dat he may come N sit upon my throne; 4 he shall be king in my stead: N I have appointed him 2 be ruler over Israel N over Judah.
N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada answered tha king, N said, Amen: tha LORD God of my lord tha king say so too.
As tha LORD has been wit my lord tha king, even so be he wit Solomon, N make his throne greater than tha throne of my lord king David.
So Zadok tha priest, N Nathan tha prophet, N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada, N tha Cherethites, N tha Pelethites, went down, N caused Solomon 2 ride upon king David’s mule, N brought him 2 Gihon.
N Zadok tha priest took an horn of oil out of tha tabernacle, N anointed Solomon. N dey blew tha trumpet; N all tha people said, God save king Solomon.
N all tha people came up after him, N tha people piped wit pipes, N rejoiced wit great joy, so dat tha earth rent wit tha sound of ’em.
N Adonijah N all tha guests dat were wit him heard it as dey had made an end of eatin. N when Joab heard tha sound of tha trumpet, he said, so is dis noise of tha city bein in an uproar?
N while he yet spoke, look, Jonathan tha son of Abiathar tha priest came: N Adonijah said 2 him, Come in; 4 u r a valiant man, N bring good tidings.
N Jonathan answered 2 Adonijah, for real our lord king David has made Solomon king.
N tha king has sent wit him Zadok tha priest, N Nathan tha prophet, N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada, N tha Cherethites, N tha Pelethites, N dey have caused him 2 ride upon tha king’s mule:
N Zadok tha priest N Nathan tha prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: N dey r come up from thence rejoicin, so dat tha city rang again. dis is tha noise dat y’all have heard.
N also Solomon sits on tha throne of tha kingdom.

N moreover tha king’s servants came 2 bless our lord king David, sayin, God make tha name of Solomon better than ur name, N make his throne greater than ur throne. N tha king bowed himself upon tha bed.
N also like dis said tha king, Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel, which has given one 2 sit on my throne dis day, my eyes even seein it.
N all tha guests dat were wit Adonijah were afraid, N rose up, N went every man his way.
N Adonijah feared because of Solomon, N arose, N went, N caught hold on tha horns of tha altar.

N it was told Solomon, sayin, look, Adonijah fears king Solomon: 4, look, he has caught hold on tha horns of tha altar, sayin, Let king Solomon swear 2 me 2 day dat he will not kill his servant wit tha sword.
N Solomon said, If he will show himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall 2 tha earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
So king Solomon sent, N dey brought him down from tha altar. N he came N bowed himself 2 king Solomon: N Solomon said 2 him, Go 2 thine house.

2.text: Now tha days of David drew nigh dat he should die; N he charged Solomon his son, sayin,
I go tha way of all tha earth: be u strong therefore, N show urself a man;

N keep tha charge of tha LORD ur God, 2 walk in his ways, 2 keep his statutes, N his commandments, N his judgments, N his testimonies, as it is written in tha law of Moses, dat u may prosper in all dat u do, N wherever u turn urself:

Dat tha LORD may continue his word which he spoke concerning me, sayin, If ur children pay attention 2 their way, 2 walk before me in truth wit all their heart N wit all their soul, there shall not fail u (said he) a man on tha throne of Israel.

Moreover u know also what Joab tha son of Zeruiah did 2 me, N what he did 2 tha two captains of tha hosts of Israel, 2 Abner tha son of Ner, N 2 Amasa tha son of Jether, whom he killed, N shed tha blood of war in peace, N put tha blood of war upon his girdle dat was about his loins, N in his shoes dat were on his feet.
Do therefore according 2 ur wisdom, N don’t let his hoar head go down 2 tha grave in peace.
But show kindness 2 tha sons of Barzillai tha Gileadite, N let ’em be of dose dat eat at ur table: 4 so dey came 2 me when I fled because of Absalom ur brother.

N, look, u have wit u Shimei tha son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me wit a grievous curse in tha day when I went 2 Mahanaim: but he came down 2 meet me at Jordan, N I sware 2 him by tha LORD, sayin, I will not put u 2 death wit tha sword.
Now therefore hold him not guiltless: 4 u r a wise man, N know what u ought 2 do 2 him; but his hoar head bring u down 2 tha grave wit blood.
So David slept wit his fathers, N was buried in tha city of David.
N tha days dat David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, N thirty N three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
Then sat Solomon upon tha throne of David his father; N his kingdom was established greatly.
N Adonijah tha son of Haggith came 2 Bath-sheba tha mother of Solomon. N she said, come u peaceably? N he said, Peaceably.
He said moreover, I have somewhat 2 say 2 u. N she said, Say on.
N he said, u know dat tha kingdom was mine, N dat all Israel set their faces on me, dat I should reign: but tha kingdom is turned about, N is become my brother’s: 4 it was his from tha LORD.
N now I ask one petition of u, deny me not. N she said 2 him, Say on.
N he said, Speak, I pray u, 2 Solomon tha king, (4 he will not say u no,) dat he give me Abishag tha Shunammite 2 wife.
N Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak 4 u 2 tha king.

Bath-sheba therefore went 2 king Solomon, 2 speak 2 him 4 Adonijah. N tha king rose up 2 meet her, N bowed himself 2 her, N sat down on his throne, N caused a seat 2 be set 4 tha king’s mother; N she sat on his right hand.
Then she said, I desire one small petition of u; I pray u, say me not no. N tha king said 2 her, Ask on, my mother: 4 I will not say u no.
N she said, Let Abishag tha Shunammite be given 2 Adonijah ur brother 2 wife.

N king Solomon answered 2 his mother, N why do u ask Abishag tha Shunammite 4 Adonijah? ask 4 him tha kingdom also; 4 he is mine elder brother; even 4 him, N 4 Abiathar tha priest, N 4 Joab tha son of Zeruiah.
Then king Solomon sware by tha LORD, sayin, God do so 2 me, N more also, if Adonijah have not spoken dis word against his own life.
Now therefore, as tha LORD lives, which has established me, N set me on tha throne of David my father, N who has made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put 2 death dis day.
N king Solomon sent by tha hand of Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada; N he fell upon him dat he died.

N 2 Abiathar tha priest said tha king, Get u 2 Anathoth, 2 ur own fields; 4 u r worthy of death: but I will not at dis time put u 2 death, because u bore tha ark of tha Lord GOD before David my father, N because u have been afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.
So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from bein priest 2 tha LORD; dat he might fulfil tha word of tha LORD, which he spoke concerning tha house of Eli in Shiloh.
Then tidings came 2 Joab: 4 Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. N Joab fled 2 tha tabernacle of tha LORD, N caught hold on tha horns of tha altar.
N it was told king Solomon dat Joab was fled 2 tha tabernacle of tha LORD; N, look, he is by tha altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada, sayin, Go, fall upon him.

N Benaiah came 2 tha tabernacle of tha LORD, N said 2 him, like dis says tha king, Come forth. N he said, no; but I will die here. N Benaiah brought tha king word again, sayin, like dis said Joab, N like dis he answered me.
N tha king said 2 him, Do as he has said, N fall upon him, N bury him; dat u may take away tha innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, N from tha house of my father.

N tha LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous N better than he, N killed ’em wit tha sword, my father David not knowin of it, 2 wit, Abner tha son of Ner, captain of tha host of Israel, N Amasa tha son of Jether, captain of tha host of Judah.

Their blood shall therefore return upon tha head of Joab, N upon tha head of his seed 4 ever: but upon David, N upon his seed, N upon his house, N upon his throne, shall there be peace 4 ever from tha LORD.
So Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada went up, N fell upon him, N killed him: N he was buried in his own house in tha wilderness.
N tha king put Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada in his room over tha host: N Zadok tha priest did tha king put in tha room of Abiathar.
N tha king sent N called 4 Shimei, N said 2 him, Build u an house in Jerusalem, N live there, N go not forth thence any where.
4 it shall be, dat on tha day u go out, N pass over tha brook Kidron, u will know 4 certain dat u will surely die: ur blood shall be upon ur own head.
N Shimei said 2 tha king, tha sayin is good: as my lord tha king has said, so will ur servant do. N Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.
N it happened at tha end of three years, dat two of tha servants of Shimei ran away 2 Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. N dey told Shimei, sayin, look, ur servants be in Gath.
N Shimei arose, N saddled his ass, N went 2 Gath 2 Achish 2 seek his servants: N Shimei went, N brought his servants from Gath.
N it was told Solomon dat Shimei had gone from Jerusalem 2 Gath, N was come again.

N tha king sent N called 4 Shimei, N said 2 him, Did I not make u 2 swear by tha LORD, N protested 2 u, sayin, Know 4 a certain, on tha day u go out, N walk abroad any where, dat u will surely die? N u said 2 me, tha word dat I have heard is good.
Why then have u not kept tha oath of tha LORD, N tha commandment dat I have charged u wit?
Tha king said moreover 2 Shimei, u know all tha wickedness which thine heart is privy 2, dat u did 2 David my father: therefore tha LORD shall return ur wickedness upon ur own head;
N king Solomon shall be blessed, N tha throne of David shall be established before tha LORD 4 ever.
So tha king commanded Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada; which went out, N fell upon him, dat he died. N tha kingdom was established in tha hand of Solomon.

3.text: N Solomon made affinity wit Pharaoh king of Egypt, N took Pharaoh’s daughter, N brought her in2 tha city of David, until he had made an end of buildin his own house, N tha house of tha LORD, N tha wall of Jerusalem round about.
Only tha people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built 2 tha name of tha LORD, until dose days.
N Solomon loved tha LORD, walkin in tha statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed N burnt incense in high places.
N tha king went 2 Gibeon 2 sacrifice there; 4 dat was tha great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon dat altar.
In Gibeon tha LORD appeared 2 Solomon in a dream by night: N God said, Ask what I shall give u.

N Solomon said, u have showed 2 ur servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before u in truth, N in righteousness, N in uprightness of heart wit u; N u have kept 4 him dis great kindness, dat u have given him a son 2 sit on his throne, as it is dis day.
N now, O LORD my God, u have made ur servant king instead of David my father: N I am but a little child: I know not how 2 go out or come in.
N ur servant is in tha midst of ur people which u have chosen, a great people, dat cannot be numbered nor counted 4 crowd.
Give therefore ur servant an understanding heart 2 judge ur people, dat I may discern between good N bad: 4 who is able 2 judge dis ur so great a people?
N tha speech pleased tha Lord, dat Solomon had asked dis thing.

N God said 2 him, Because u have asked dis thing, N have not asked 4 urself long life; neither have asked riches 4 urself, nor have asked tha life of thine opps; but have asked 4 urself understanding 2 discern judgment;
Look, I have done according 2 ur words: look, I have given u a wise N an understanding heart; so dat there was none like u before u, neither after u shall any arise like 2 u.
N I have also given u dat which u have not asked, both riches, N honour: so dat there shall not be any among tha kings like 2 u all ur days.
N if u will walk in my ways, 2 keep my statutes N my commandments, as ur father David did walk, then I will lengthen ur days.

N Solomon awoke; N, look, it was a dream. N he came 2 Jerusalem, N stood before tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD, N offered up burnt offerings, N offered peace offerings, N made a feast 2 all his servants.
Then came there two women, dat were harlots, 2 tha king, N stood before him.
N tha one woman said, O my lord, I N dis woman live in one house; N I was delivered of a child wit her in tha house.
N it happened tha third day after dat I was delivered, dat dis woman was delivered also: N we were together; there was no stranger wit us in tha house, save we two in tha house.
N dis woman’s child died in tha night; because she overlaid it.
N she arose at midnight, N took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, N laid it in her bosom, N laid her dead child in my bosom.
N when I rose in tha morning 2 give my child suck, look, it was dead: but when I had considered it in tha morning, look, it was not my son, which I did bear.
N tha other woman said, no; but tha livin is my son, N tha dead is ur son. N dis said, No; but tha dead is ur son, N tha livin is my son. like dis dey spoke before tha king.
Then said tha king, tha one says, dis is my son dat lives, N ur son is tha dead: N tha other says, no; but ur son is tha dead, N my son is tha livin.
N tha king said, Bring me a sword. N dey brought a sword before tha king.
N tha king said, Divide tha livin child in two, N give half 2 tha one, N half 2 tha other.

Then spoke tha woman whose tha livin child was 2 tha king, 4 her bowels yearned upon her son, N she said, O my lord, give her tha livin child, N in no wise kill it. But tha other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
Then tha king answered, Give her tha livin child, N in no wise kill it: she is tha mother of it.
N all Israel heard of tha judgment which tha king had judged; N dey feared tha king: 4 dey saw dat tha wisdom of God was in him, 2 do judgment.

4.text: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
N dese were tha princes which he had; Azariah tha son of Zadok tha priest,
Elihoreph N Ahiah, tha sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat tha son of Ahilud, tha recorder.
N Benaiah tha son of Jehoiada was over tha host: N Zadok N Abiathar were tha priests:
N Azariah tha son of Nathan was over tha officers: N Zabud tha son of Nathan was principal officer, N tha king’s friend:
N Ahishar was over tha household: N Adoniram tha son of Abda was over tha tribute.
N Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided food 4 tha king N his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
N dese r their namez: tha son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
Tha son of Dekar, in Makaz, N in Shaalbim, N Beth-shemesh, N Elon-beth-hanan:
Tha son of Hesed, in Aruboth; 2 him pertained Sochoh, N all tha land of Hepher:
Tha son of Abinadab, in all tha region of Dor; which had Taphath tha daughter of Solomon 2 wife:
Baana tha son of Ahilud; 2 him pertained Taanach N Megiddo, N all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean 2 Abel-meholah, even 2 tha place dat is beyond Jokneam:

Tha son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; 2 him pertained tha towns of Jair tha son of Manasseh, which r in Gilead; 2 him also pertained tha region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great citiez wit walls N brasen bars:
Ahinadab tha son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath tha daughter of Solomon 2 wife:
Baanah tha son of Hushai was in Asher N in Aloth:
Jehoshaphat tha son of Paruah, in Issachar:
Shimei tha son of Elah, in Benjamin:
Geber tha son of Uri was in tha country of Gilead, in tha country of Sihon king of tha Amorites, N of Og king of Bashan; N he was tha only officer which was in tha land.
Judah N Israel were many, as tha sand which is by tha sea in crowd, eatin N drinkin, N makin merry.
N Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from tha river 2 tha land of tha Philistines, N 2 tha border of Egypt: dey brought presents, N served Solomon all tha days of his life.
N Solomon’s provision 4 one day was thirty measures of fine flour, N threescore measures of meal,
Ten fat oxen, N twenty oxen out of tha pastures, N an hundred sheep, beside harts, N roebucks, N fallowdeer, N fatted fowl.
4 he had dominion over all tha region on dis side tha river, from Tiphsah even 2 Azzah, over all tha kings on dis side tha river: N he had peace on all sides round about him.
N Judah N Israel lived safely, every man under his vine N under his fig tree, from Dan even 2 Beer-sheba, all tha days of Solomon.
N Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses 4 his chariots, N twelve thousand horsemen.
N dose officers provided victual 4 king Solomon, N 4 all dat came 2 king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: dey lacked nothing.
Barley also N straw 4 tha horses N dromedaries brought dey 2 tha place where tha officers were, every man according 2 his charge.
N God gave Solomon wisdom N understanding exceeding much, N largeness of heart, even as tha sand dat is on tha sea shore.
N Solomon’s wisdom excelled tha wisdom of all tha children of tha east country, N all tha wisdom of Egypt.
4 he was wiser than all men; than Ethan tha Ezrahite, N Heman, N Chalcol, N Darda, tha sons of Mahol: N his fame was in all nations round about.
N he spoke three thousand proverbs: N his songs were a thousand N five.
N he spoke of trees, from tha cedar tree dat is in Lebanon even 2 tha hyssop dat springeth out of tha wall: he spoke also of beasts, N of fowl, N of creeping things, N of fishes.
N there came of all people 2 hear tha wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of tha earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

5.text: N Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants 2 Solomon; 4 he had heard dat dey had anointed him king in tha room of his father: 4 Hiram was ever a lover of David.
u know how dat David my father could not build an house 2 tha name of tha LORD his God 4 tha wars which were about him on every side, until tha LORD put ’em under tha soles of his feet.
But now tha LORD my God has given me rest on every side, so dat there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
N, look, I purpose 2 build an house 2 tha name of tha LORD my God, as tha LORD spoke 2 David my father, sayin, ur son, whom I will set upon ur throne in ur room, he shall build an house 2 my name.

Now therefore command u dat dey hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; N my servants shall be wit ur servants: N 2 u will I give hire 4 ur servants according 2 all dat u will appoint: 4 u know dat there is not among us any dat can skill 2 hew timber like 2 tha Sidonians.
N it happened, when Hiram heard tha words of Solomon, dat he rejoiced greatly, N said, Blessed be tha LORD dis day, which has given 2 David a wise son over dis great people.
N Hiram sent 2 Solomon, sayin, I have considered tha things which u sentest 2 me 4: N I will do all ur desire concerning timber of cedar, N concerning timber of fir.

My servants shall bring ’em down from Lebanon 2 tha sea: N I will convey ’em by sea in floats 2 tha place dat u will appoint me, N will cause ’em 2 be discharged there, N u will receive ’em: N u will accomplish my desire, in givin food 4 my household.
So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees N fir trees according 2 all his desire.
N Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat 4 food 2 his household, N twenty measures of pure oil: like dis gave Solomon 2 Hiram year by year.
N tha LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: N there was peace between Hiram N Solomon; N dey two made a league together.
N king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; N tha levy was thirty thousand men.
N he sent ’em 2 Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month dey were in Lebanon, N two months at home: N Adoniram was over tha levy.
N Solomon had threescore N ten thousand dat bare burdens, N fourscore thousand hewers in tha mountains;
Beside tha chief of Solomon’s officers which were over tha work, three thousand N three hundred, which ruled over tha people dat wrought in tha work.
N tha king commanded, N dey brought great stones, costly stones, N hewed stones, 2 lay tha foundation of tha house.
N Solomon’s builders N Hiram’s builders did hew ’em, N tha stonesquarers: so dey prepared timber N stones 2 build tha house.

6.text: N it happened in tha four hundred N eightieth year after tha children of Israel were come out of tha land of Egypt, in tha fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in tha month Zif, which is tha second month, dat he began 2 build tha house of tha LORD.
N tha house which king Solomon built 4 tha LORD, tha length of it was threescore cubits, N tha breadth of it twenty cubits, N tha height of it thirty cubits.
N tha porch before tha temple of tha house, twenty cubits was tha length of it, according 2 tha breadth of tha house; N ten cubits was tha breadth of it before tha house.
N 4 tha house he made windows of narrow lights.
N against tha wall of tha house he built chambers round about, against tha walls of tha house round about, both of tha temple N of tha oracle: N he made chambers round about:

Tha nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, N tha middle was six cubits broad, N tha third was seven cubits broad: 4 without in tha wall of tha house he made narrowed rests round about, dat tha beams should not be fastened in tha walls of tha house.

N tha house, when it was in buildin, was built of stone made ready before it was brought there: so dat there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in tha house, while it was in buildin.
Tha door 4 tha middle chamber was in tha right side of tha house: N dey went up wit winding stairs in2 tha middle chamber, N out of tha middle in2 tha third.
So he built tha house, N finished it; N covered tha house wit beams N boards of cedar.
N then he built chambers against all tha house, five cubits high: N dey rested on tha house wit timber of cedar.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 Solomon, sayin,

Concerning dis house which u r in buildin, if u will walk in my statutes, N execute my judgments, N keep all my commandments 2 walk in ’em; then will I perform my word wit u, which I spoke 2 David ur father:
N I will live among tha children of Israel, N will not forsake my people Israel.
So Solomon built tha house, N finished it.

N he built tha walls of tha house within wit boards of cedar, both tha floor of tha house, N tha walls of tha cieling: N he covered ’em on tha inside wit wood, N covered tha floor of tha house wit planks of fir.
N he built twenty cubits on tha sides of tha house, both tha floor N tha walls wit boards of cedar: he even built ’em 4 it within, even 4 tha oracle, even 4 tha most holy place.

So king Solomon exceeded all tha kings of tha earth 4 riches N 4 wisdom.
N all tha earth sought 2 Solomon, 2 hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
N dey brought every man his present, vessels of silver, N vessels of gold, N garments, N armour, N spices, horses, N mules, a rate year by year.
N Solomon gathered together chariots N horsemen: N he had a thousand N four hundred chariots, N twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in tha citiez 4 chariots, N wit tha king at Jerusalem.
N tha king made silver 2 be in Jerusalem as stones, N cedars made he 2 be as tha sycomore trees dat r in tha vale, 4 abundance.
N Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, N linen yarn: tha king’s merchants received tha linen yarn at a price.

N a chariot came up N went out of Egypt 4 six hundred shekels of silver, N an horse 4 an hundred N fifty: N so 4 all tha kings of tha Hittites, N 4 tha kings of Syria, did dey bring ’em out by their means.

11.text: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together wit tha daughter of Pharaoh, women of tha Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, N Hittites;

Of tha nations concerning which tha LORD said 2 tha children of Israel, y’all shall not go in 2 ’em, neither shall dey come in 2 u: 4 surely dey will turn away ur heart after their gods: Solomon clave 2 dese in love.
N he had seven hundred wives, princesses, N three hundred concubines: N his wives turned away his heart.
4 it happened, when Solomon was old, dat his wives turned away his heart after other gods: N his heart was not perfect wit tha LORD his God, as was tha heart of David his father.
4 Solomon went after Ashtoreth tha goddess of tha Zidonians, N after Milcom tha abomination of tha Ammonites.
N Solomon did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N went not fully after tha LORD, as did David his father.
Then did Solomon build an high place 4 Chemosh, tha abomination of Moab, in tha hill dat is before Jerusalem, N 4 Molech, tha abomination of tha children of Ammon.
N likewise did he 4 all his strange wives, which burnt incense N sacrificed 2 their gods.
N tha LORD was angry wit Solomon, because his heart was turned from tha LORD God of Israel, which had appeared 2 him twice,
N had commanded him concerning dis thing, dat he should not go after other gods: but he kept not dat which tha LORD commanded.
So tha LORD said 2 Solomon, Forasmuch as dis is done of u, N u have not kept my covenant N my statutes, which I have commanded u, I will surely rend tha kingdom from u, N will give it 2 ur servant.
Even so in ur days I will not do it 4 David ur father’s sake: but I will rend it out of tha hand of ur son.
But I will not rend away all tha kingdom; but will give one tribe 2 ur son 4 David my servant’s sake, N 4 Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
N tha LORD stirred up an adversary 2 Solomon, Hadad tha Edomite: he was of tha king’s seed in Edom.
4 it happened, when David was in Edom, N Joab tha captain of tha host was gone up 2 bury tha killed, after he had struck every male in Edom;
(4 six months did Joab remain there wit all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
Dat Hadad fled, he N certain Edomites of his father’s servants wit him, 2 go in2 Egypt; Hadad bein yet a little child.
N dey arose out of Midian, N came 2 Paran: N dey took men wit ’em out of Paran, N dey came 2 Egypt, 2 Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, N appointed him food, N gave him land.
N Hadad found great favour in tha sight of Pharaoh, so dat he gave him 2 wife tha sister of his own wife, tha sister of Tahpenes tha queen.
N tha sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: N Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among tha sons of Pharaoh.
N when Hadad heard in Egypt dat David slept wit his fathers, N dat Joab tha captain of tha host was dead, Hadad said 2 Pharaoh, Let me depart, dat I may go 2 my own country.
Then Pharaoh said 2 him, But what have u lacked wit me, dat, look, u seek 2 go 2 ur own country? N he answered, Nothing: but let me go in any wise.
N God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon tha son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
N he gathered men 2 him, N became captain over a band, when David killed ’em of Zobah: N dey went 2 Damascus, N lived in it, N reigned in Damascus.
N he was an adversary 2 Israel all tha days of Solomon, beside tha mischief dat Hadad did: N he abhorred Israel, N reigned over Syria.
N Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against tha king.
N dis was tha cause dat he lifted up his hand against tha king: Solomon built Millo, N repaired tha breaches of tha city of David his father.
N tha man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: N Solomon seein tha young man dat he was industrious, he made him ruler over all tha charge of tha house of Joseph.
N it happened at dat time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, dat tha prophet Ahijah tha Shilonite found him in tha way; N he had clad himself wit a new garment; N dey two were alone in tha field:
N Ahijah caught tha new garment dat was on him, N rent it in twelve pieces:
N he said 2 Jeroboam, Take u ten pieces: 4 like dis says tha LORD, tha God of Israel, look, I will rend tha kingdom out of tha hand of Solomon, N will give ten tribes 2 u:
(But he shall have one tribe 4 my servant David’s sake, N 4 Jerusalem’s sake, tha city which I have chosen out of all tha tribes of Israel:)

Because dat dey have forsaken me, N have worshipped Ashtoreth tha goddess of tha Zidonians, Chemosh tha god of tha Moabites, N Milcom tha god of tha children of Ammon, N have not walked in my ways, 2 do dat which is right in my eyes, N 2 keep my statutes N my judgments, as did David his father.
But I will not take tha whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all tha days of his life 4 David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments N my statutes:
But I will take tha kingdom out of his son’s hand, N will give it 2 u, even ten tribes.
N 2 his son will I give one tribe, dat David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, tha city which I have chosen me 2 put my name there.
N I will take u, N u will reign according 2 all dat ur soul desires, N will be king over Israel.

N it will be, if u will listen 2 all dat I command u, N wilt walk in my ways, N do dat is right in my sight, 2 keep my statutes N my commandments, as David my servant did; dat I will be wit u, N build u a sure house, as I built 4 David, N will give Israel 2 u.
N I will 4 dis afflict tha seed of David, but not 4 ever.
Solomon sought therefore 2 kill Jeroboam. N Jeroboam arose, N fled in2 Egypt, 2 Shishak king of Egypt, N was in Egypt until tha death of Solomon.
N tha rest of tha acts of Solomon, N all dat he did, N his wisdom, r dey not written in tha book of tha acts of Solomon?
N tha time dat Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
N Solomon slept wit his fathers, N was buried in tha city of David his father: N Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

12.text: N Rehoboam went 2 Shechem: 4 all Israel were come 2 Shechem 2 make him king.
N it happened, when Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (4 he was fled from tha presence of king Solomon, N Jeroboam lived in Egypt;)
Dat dey sent N called him. N Jeroboam N all tha congregation of Israel came, N spoke 2 Rehoboam, sayin,
Ur father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make u tha grievous service of ur father, N his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, N we will serve u.
N he said 2 ’em, Depart yet 4 three days, then come again 2 me. N tha people departed.
N king Rehoboam consulted wit tha old men, dat stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, N said, How do y’all advise dat I may answer dis people?
N dey spoke 2 him, sayin, If u will be a servant 2 dis people dis day, N wilt serve ’em, N answer ’em, N speak good words 2 ’em, then dey will be ur servants 4 ever.
But he forsook tha counsel of tha old men, which dey had given him, N consulted wit tha young men dat were grown up wit him, N which stood before him:
N he said 2 ’em, What counsel give y’all dat we may answer dis people, who have spoken 2 me, sayin, Make tha yoke which ur father did put upon us lighter?

N tha young men dat were grown up wit him spoke 2 him, sayin, like dis will u speak 2 dis people dat spoke 2 u, sayin, ur father made our yoke heavy, but make u it lighter 2 us; like dis will u say 2 ’em, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
N now whereas my father did lade u wit a heavy yoke, I will add 2 ur yoke: my father has chastised u wit whips, but I will chastise u wit scorpions.
So Jeroboam N all tha people came 2 Rehoboam tha third day, as tha king had appointed, sayin, Come 2 me again tha third day.
N tha king answered tha people roughly, N forsook tha old men’s counsel dat dey gave him;
N spoke 2 ’em after tha counsel of tha young men, sayin, My father made ur yoke heavy, N I will add 2 ur yoke: my father also chastised u wit whips, but I will chastise u wit scorpions.
So tha king listened not 2 tha people; 4 tha cause was from tha LORD, dat he might perform his sayin, which tha LORD spoke by Ahijah tha Shilonite 2 Jeroboam tha son of Nebat.

So when all Israel saw dat tha king listened not 2 ’em, tha people answered tha king, sayin, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in tha son of Jesse: 2 ur tents, O Israel: now see 2 ur own house, David. So Israel departed 2 their tents.
But as 4 tha children of Israel which lived in tha citiez of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over ’em.
Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over tha tribute; N all Israel stoned him wit stones, dat he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed 2 get him up 2 his chariot, 2 flee 2 Jerusalem.
So Israel rebelled against tha house of David 2 dis day.

N it happened, when all Israel heard dat Jeroboam was come again, dat dey sent N called him 2 tha congregation, N made him king over all Israel: there was none dat followed tha house of David, but tha tribe of Judah only.

N when Rehoboam was come 2 Jerusalem, he assembled all tha house of Judah, wit tha tribe of Benjamin, an hundred N fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, 2 fight against tha house of Israel, 2 bring tha kingdom again 2 Rehoboam tha son of Solomon.
But tha word of God came 2 Shemaiah tha man of God, sayin,
Speak 2 Rehoboam, tha son of Solomon, king of Judah, N 2 all tha house of Judah N Benjamin, N 2 tha remnant of tha people, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD, y’all shall not go up, nor fight against ur brothers tha children of Israel: return every man 2 his house; 4 dis thing is from me. dey listened therefore 2 tha word of tha LORD, N returned 2 depart, according 2 tha word of tha LORD.
Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, N lived in it; N went out from thence, N built Penuel.
N Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall tha kingdom return 2 tha house of David:

If dis people go up 2 do sacrifice in tha house of tha LORD at Jerusalem, then shall tha heart of dis people turn again 2 their lord, even 2 Rehoboam king of Judah, N dey shall kill me, N go again 2 Rehoboam king of Judah.
Whereupon tha king took counsel, N made two calves of gold, N said 2 ’em, It is too much 4 u 2 go up 2 Jerusalem: look ur gods, O Israel, which brought u up out of tha land of Egypt.
N he set tha one in Beth-el, N tha other put he in Dan.
N dis thing became a sin: 4 tha people went 2 worship before tha one, even 2 Dan.
N he made an house of high places, N made priests of tha lowest of tha people, which were not of tha sons of Levi.

N Jeroboam ordained a feast in tha eighth month, on tha fifteenth day of tha month, like 2 tha feast dat is in Judah, N he offered upon tha altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing 2 tha calves dat he had made: N he placed in Beth-el tha priests of tha high places which he had made.

So he offered upon tha altar which he had made in Beth-el tha fifteenth day of tha eighth month, even in tha month which he had devised of his own heart; N ordained a feast 2 tha children of Israel: N he offered upon tha altar, N burnt incense.

13.text: N, look, there came a man of God out of Judah by tha word of tha LORD 2 Beth-el: N Jeroboam stood by tha altar 2 burn incense.

N he cried against tha altar in tha word of tha LORD, N said, O altar, altar, like dis says tha LORD; look, a child shall be born 2 tha house of David, Josiah by name; N upon u shall he offer tha priests of tha high places dat burn incense upon u, N men’s bones shall be burnt upon u.
N he gave a sign tha same day, sayin, dis is tha sign which tha LORD has spoken; look, tha altar shall be rent, N tha ashes dat r upon it shall be poured out.

N it happened, when king Jeroboam heard tha sayin of tha man of God, which had cried against tha altar in Beth-el, dat he put forth his hand from tha altar, sayin, Lay hold on him. N his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so dat he could not pull it in again 2 him.
Tha altar also was rent, N tha ashes poured out from tha altar, according 2 tha sign which tha man of God had given by tha word of tha LORD.

N tha king answered 2 tha man of God, Intreat now tha face of tha LORD ur God, N pray 4 me, dat my hand may be restored me again. N tha man of God besought tha LORD, N tha king’s hand was restored him again, N became as it was before., N: Heb. tha face of tha LORD, etc
N tha king said 2 tha man of God, Come home wit me, N refresh urself, N I will give u a reward.
N tha man of God said 2 tha king, If u will give me half thine house, I will not go in wit u, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in dis place:
4 so was it charged me by tha word of tha LORD, sayin, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by tha same way dat u came.
So he went another way, N returned not by tha way dat he came 2 Beth-el.

Now there lived an old prophet in Beth-el; N his sons came N told him all tha works dat tha man of God had done dat day in Beth-el: tha words which he had spoken 2 tha king, ’em dey told also 2 their father.
N their father said 2 ’em, What way went he? 4 his sons had seen what way tha man of God went, which came from Judah.
N he said 2 his sons, Saddle me tha ass. So dey saddled him tha ass: N he rode thereon,
N went after tha man of God, N found him sittin under an oak: N he said 2 him, r u tha man of God dat came from Judah? N he said, I am.
Then he said 2 him, Come home wit me, N eat bread.
N he said, I may not return wit u, nor go in wit u: neither will I eat bread nor drink water wit u in dis place:
4 it was said 2 me by tha word of tha LORD, u will eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again 2 go by tha way dat u came.
He said 2 him, I am a prophet also as u r; N an angel spoke 2 me by tha word of tha LORD, sayin, Bring him back wit u in2 thine house, dat he may eat bread N drink water. But he lied 2 him.
So he went back wit him, N did eat bread in his house, N drank water.
N it happened, as dey sat at tha table, dat tha word of tha LORD came 2 tha prophet dat brought him back:
N he cried 2 tha man of God dat came from Judah, sayin, like dis says tha LORD, Forasmuch as u have disobeyed tha mouth of tha LORD, N have not kept tha commandment which tha LORD ur God commanded u,
But came back, N have eaten bread N drunk water in tha place, of tha which tha Lord did say 2 u, Eat no bread, N drink no water; ur carcase shall not come 2 tha sepulchre of ur fathers.
N it happened, after he had eaten bread, N after he had drunk, dat he saddled 4 him tha ass, 2 wit, 4 tha prophet whom he had brought back.
N when he was gone, a lion met him by tha way, N killed him: N his carcase was cast in tha way, N tha ass stood by it, tha lion also stood by tha carcase.
N, look, men passed by, N saw tha carcase cast in tha way, N tha lion standin by tha carcase: N dey came N told it in tha city where tha old prophet lived.

N when tha prophet dat brought him back from tha way heard of it, he said, It is tha man of God, who was disobedient 2 tha word of tha LORD: therefore tha LORD has delivered him 2 tha lion, which has torn him, N killed him, according 2 tha word of tha LORD, which he spoke 2 him.
N he spoke 2 his sons, sayin, Saddle me tha ass. N dey saddled him.
N he went N found his carcase cast in tha way, N tha ass N tha lion standin by tha carcase: tha lion had not eaten tha carcase, nor torn tha ass.
N tha prophet took up tha carcase of tha man of God, N laid it upon tha ass, N brought it back: N tha old prophet came 2 tha city, 2 mourn N 2 bury him.
N he laid his carcase in his own grave; N dey mourned over him, sayin, Alas, my brother!
N it happened, after he had buried him, dat he spoke 2 his sons, sayin, When I am dead, then bury me in tha sepulchre in which tha man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
4 tha sayin which he cried by tha word of tha LORD against tha altar in Beth-el, N against all tha houses of tha high places which r in tha citiez of Samaria, shall surely come 2 pass.

After dis thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of tha lowest of tha people priests of tha high places: whoever would, he consecrated him, N he became one of tha priests of tha high places.
N dis thing became sin 2 tha house of Jeroboam, even 2 cut it off, N 2 destroy it from off tha face of tha earth.

14.text: At dat time Abijah tha son of Jeroboam fell sick.

N Jeroboam said 2 his wife, Arise, I pray u, N disguise urself, dat u don’t be known 2 be tha wife of Jeroboam; N get u 2 Shiloh: look, there is Ahijah tha prophet, which told me dat I should be king over dis people.
N take wit u ten loaves, N cracknels, N a cruse of honey, N go 2 him: he shall tell u what shall become of tha child.
N Jeroboam’s wife did so, N arose, N went 2 Shiloh, N came 2 tha house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; 4 his eyes were set by reason of his age.

N tha LORD said 2 Ahijah, look, tha wife of Jeroboam comes 2 ask a thing of u 4 her son; 4 he is sick: like dis N like dis will u say 2 her: 4 it shall be, when she comes in, dat she shall feign herself 2 be another woman.
N it was so, when Ahijah heard tha sound of her feet, as she came in at tha door, dat he said, Come in, u wife of Jeroboam; why feignest u urself 2 be another? 4 I am sent 2 u wit heavy tidings.
Go, tell Jeroboam, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted u from among tha people, N made u prince over my people Israel,

N rent tha kingdom away from tha house of David, N gave it u: N yet u have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, N who followed me wit all his heart, 2 do dat only which was right in my eyes;
But have done evil above all dat were before u: 4 u have gone N made u other gods, N molten images, 2 provoke me 2 anger, N have cast me behind ur back:

Therefore, look, I will bring evil upon tha house of Jeroboam, N will cut off from Jeroboam him dat pisses against tha wall, N him dat is shut up N left in Israel, N will take away tha remnant of tha house of Jeroboam, as a man takes away dung, till it be all gone.
Him dat dies of Jeroboam in tha city shall tha dogs eat; N him dat dies in tha field shall tha fowls of tha air eat: 4 tha LORD has spoken it.
Arise u therefore, get u 2 ur own house: N when ur feet enter in2 tha city, tha child shall die.
N all Israel shall mourn 4 him, N bury him: 4 he only of Jeroboam shall come 2 tha grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward tha LORD God of Israel in tha house of Jeroboam.
Moreover tha LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off tha house of Jeroboam dat day: but what? even now.

4 tha LORD shall strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in tha water, N he shall root up Israel out of dis good land, which he gave 2 their fathers, N shall scatter ’em beyond tha river, because dey have made their groves, provoking tha LORD 2 anger.
N he shall give Israel up because of tha sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, N who made Israel 2 sin.
N Jeroboam’s wife arose, N departed, N came 2 Tirzah: N when she came 2 tha threshold of tha door, tha child died;
N dey buried him; N all Israel mourned 4 him, according 2 tha word of tha LORD, which he spoke by tha hand of his servant Ahijah tha prophet.
N tha rest of tha acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, N how he reigned, look, dey r written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Israel.
N tha days which Jeroboam reigned were two N twenty years: N he slept wit his fathers, N Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

N Rehoboam tha son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty N one years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, tha city which tha LORD did choose out of all tha tribes of Israel, 2 put his name there. N his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
N Judah did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N dey provoked him 2 jealousy wit their sins which dey had committed, above all dat their fathers had done.
4 dey also built ’em high places, N images, N groves, on every high hill, N under every green tree.
N there were also sodomites in tha land: N dey did according 2 all tha abominations of tha nations which tha LORD cast out before tha children of Israel.
N it happened in tha fifth year of king Rehoboam, dat Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
N he took away tha treasures of tha house of tha LORD, N tha treasures of tha king’s house; he even took away all: N he took away all tha shields of gold which Solomon had made.
N king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, N committed ’em 2 tha hands of tha chief of tha guard, which kept tha door of tha king’s house.
N it was so, when tha king went in2 tha house of tha LORD, dat tha guard bare ’em, N brought ’em back in2 tha guard chamber.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Rehoboam, N all dat he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
N there was war between Rehoboam N Jeroboam all their days.
N Rehoboam slept wit his fathers, N was buried wit his fathers in tha city of David. N his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. N Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

15.text: Now in tha eighteenth year of king Jeroboam tha son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Maachah, tha daughter of Abishalom.
N he walked in all tha sins of his father, which he had done before him: N his heart was not perfect wit tha LORD his God, as tha heart of David his father.
Nevertheless 4 David’s sake did tha LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, 2 set up his son after him, N 2 establish Jerusalem:
Because David did dat which was right in tha eyes of tha LORD, N turned not aside from any thing dat he commanded him all tha days of his life, save only in tha matter of Uriah tha Hittite.
N there was war between Rehoboam N Jeroboam all tha days of his life.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Abijam, N all dat he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah? N there was war between Abijam N Jeroboam.
N Abijam slept wit his fathers; N dey buried him in tha city of David: N Asa his son reigned in his stead.
N in tha twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
N forty N one years reigned he in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Maachah, tha daughter of Abishalom.
N Asa did dat which was right in tha eyes of tha LORD, as did David his father.
N he took away tha sodomites out of tha land, N removed all tha idols dat his fathers had made.
N also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from bein queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; N Asa destroyed her idol, N burnt it by tha brook Kidron.
But tha high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect wit tha LORD all his days.
N he brought in tha things which his father had dedicated, N tha things which himself had dedicated, in2 tha house of tha LORD, silver, N gold, N vessels.
N there was war between Asa N Baasha king of Israel all their days.
N Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, N built Ramah, dat he might not suffer any 2 go out or come in 2 Asa king of Judah.

Then Asa took all tha silver N tha gold dat were left in tha treasures of tha house of tha LORD, N tha treasures of tha king’s house, N delivered ’em in2 tha hand of his servants: N king Asa sent ’em 2 Ben-hadad, tha son of Tabrimon, tha son of Hezion, king of Syria, dat lived at Damascus, sayin,
There is a league between me N u, N between my father N ur father: look, I have sent 2 u a present of silver N gold; come N break ur league wit Baasha king of Israel, dat he may depart from me.
So Ben-hadad listened 2 king Asa, N sent tha captains of tha hosts which he had against tha citiez of Israel, N struck Ijon, N Dan, N Abel-beth-maachah, N all Cinneroth, wit all tha land of Naphtali.
N it happened, when Baasha heard of it, dat he left off buildin of Ramah, N lived in Tirzah.

Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: N dey took away tha stones of Ramah, N tha timber of it, wherewith Baasha had builded; N king Asa built wit ’em Geba of Benjamin, N Mizpah.

Tha rest of all tha acts of Asa, N all his might, N all dat he did, N tha citiez which he built, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah? Nevertheless in tha time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
N Asa slept wit his fathers, N was buried wit his fathers in tha city of David his father: N Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
N Nadab tha son of Jeroboam began 2 reign over Israel in tha second year of Asa king of Judah, N reigned over Israel two years.
N he did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N walked in tha way of his father, N in his sin wherewith he made Israel 2 sin.
N Baasha tha son of Ahijah, of tha house of Issachar, conspired against him; N Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged 2 tha Philistines; 4 Nadab N all Israel laid siege 2 Gibbethon.
Even in tha third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha kill him, N reigned in his stead.

N it happened, when he reigned, dat he struck all tha house of Jeroboam; he left not 2 Jeroboam any dat breathed, until he had destroyed him, according 2 tha sayin of tha LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah tha Shilonite:
Because of tha sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, N which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked tha LORD God of Israel 2 anger.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Nadab, N all dat he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Israel?
N there was war between Asa N Baasha king of Israel all their days.
In tha third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha tha son of Ahijah 2 reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty N four years.
N he did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N walked in tha way of Jeroboam, N in his sin wherewith he made Israel 2 sin.

16.text: Then tha word of tha LORD came 2 Jehu tha son of Hanani against Baasha, sayin,
Forasmuch as I exalted u out of tha dust, N made u prince over my people Israel; N u have walked in tha way of Jeroboam, N have made my people Israel 2 sin, 2 provoke me 2 anger wit their sins;
Look, I will take away tha posterity of Baasha, N tha posterity of his house; N will make ur house like tha house of Jeroboam tha son of Nebat.

18.text: N it happened after many days, dat tha word of tha LORD came 2 Elijah in tha third year, sayin, Go, show urself 2 Ahab; N I will send rain upon tha earth.

Let ’em therefore give us two bullocks; N let ’em choose one bullock 4 themselves, N cut it in pieces, N lay it on wood, N put no fire under: N I will dress tha other bullock, N lay it on wood, N put no fire under:

N tha men of his city, even tha elders N tha nobles who were tha inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent 2 ’em, N as it was written in tha letters which she had sent 2 ’em.
Dey proclaimed a fast, N set Naboth on high among tha people.

N there came in two men, children of Belial, N sat before him: N tha men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in tha presence of tha people, sayin, Naboth did blaspheme God N tha king. Then dey carried him forth out of tha city, N stoned him wit stones, dat he died.
Then dey sent 2 Jezebel, sayin, Naboth is stoned, N is dead.

N it happened, when Jezebel heard dat Naboth was stoned, N was dead, dat Jezebel said 2 Ahab, Arise, take possession of tha vineyard of Naboth tha Jezreelite, which he refused 2 give u 4 money: 4 Naboth is not alive, but dead.
N it happened, when Ahab heard dat Naboth was dead, dat Ahab rose up 2 go down 2 tha vineyard of Naboth tha Jezreelite, 2 take possession of it.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 Elijah tha Tishbite, sayin,
Arise, go down 2 meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: look, he is in tha vineyard of Naboth, where he is gone down 2 possess it.

N u will speak 2 him, sayin, like dis says tha LORD, have u killed, N also taken possession? N u will speak 2 him, sayin, like dis says tha LORD, In tha place where dogs licked tha blood of Naboth shall dogs lick ur blood, even thine.
N Ahab said 2 Elijah, have u found me, O mine opp? N he answered, I have found u: because u have sold urself 2 work evil in tha sight of tha LORD.
Look, I will bring evil upon u, N will take away ur posterity, N will cut off from Ahab him dat pisses against tha wall, N him dat is shut up N left in Israel,
N will make thine house like tha house of Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, N like tha house of Baasha tha son of Ahijah, 4 tha provocation wherewith u have provoked me 2 anger, N made Israel 2 sin.
N of Jezebel also spoke tha LORD, sayin, tha dogs shall eat Jezebel by tha wall of Jezreel.
Him dat dies of Ahab in tha city tha dogs shall eat; N him dat dies in tha field shall tha fowls of tha air eat.
But there was none like 2 Ahab, which did sell himself 2 work wickedness in tha sight of tha LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
N he did very abominably in followin idols, according 2 all things as did tha Amorites, whom tha LORD cast out before tha children of Israel.
N it happened, when Ahab heard dose words, dat he rent his clothes, N put sackcloth upon his flesh, N fasted, N lay in sackcloth, N went softly.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 Elijah tha Tishbite, sayin,
See u how Ahab humbles himself before me? because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring tha evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring tha evil upon his house.

22.text: N dey continued three years without war between Syria N Israel.
N it happened in tha third year, dat Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah came down 2 tha king of Israel.
N tha king of Israel said 2 his servants, Know y’all dat Ramoth in Gilead is ours, N we be still, N take it not out of tha hand of tha king of Syria?
N he said 2 Jehoshaphat, will u go wit me 2 battle 2 Ramoth-gilead? N Jehoshaphat said 2 tha king of Israel, I am as u r, my people as ur people, my horses as ur horses.
N Jehoshaphat said 2 tha king of Israel, Enquire, I pray u, at tha word of tha LORD 2 day.

Then tha king of Israel gathered tha prophets together, about four hundred men, N said 2 ’em, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead 2 battle, or shall I forbear? N dey said, Go up; 4 tha Lord shall deliver it in2 tha hand of tha king.
N Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of tha LORD besides, dat we might enquire of him?

N tha king of Israel said 2 Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah tha son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of tha LORD: but I hate him; 4 he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. N Jehoshaphat said, don’t let tha king say so.
Then tha king of Israel called an officer, N said, Hasten here Micaiah tha son of Imlah.

N tha king of Israel N Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah sat each on his throne, havin put on their robes, in a void place in tha entrance of tha gate of Samaria; N all tha prophets prophesied before ’em.
N Zedekiah tha son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: N he said, like dis says tha LORD, wit dese will u push tha Syrians, until u have consumed ’em.
N all tha prophets prophesied so, sayin, Go up 2 Ramoth-gilead, N prosper: 4 tha LORD shall deliver it in2 tha king’s hand.

N tha messenger dat was gone 2 call Micaiah spoke 2 him, sayin, look now, tha words of tha prophets declare good 2 tha king wit one mouth: let ur word, I pray u, be like tha word of one of ’em, N speak dat which is good.
N Micaiah said, As tha LORD lives, what tha LORD says 2 me, dat will I speak.

So he came 2 tha king. N tha king said 2 him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead 2 battle, or shall we forbear? N he answered him, Go, N prosper: 4 tha LORD shall deliver it in2 tha hand of tha king.
N tha king said 2 him, How many times shall I adjure u dat u tell me nothing but dat which is true in tha name of tha LORD?
N he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon tha hills, as sheep dat have not a shepherd: N tha LORD said, dese have no master: let ’em return every man 2 his house in peace.
N tha king of Israel said 2 Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell u dat he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
N he said, Hear u therefore tha word of tha LORD: I saw tha LORD sittin on his throne, N all tha host of heaven standin by him on his right hand N on his left.
N tha LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, dat he may go up N fall at Ramoth-gilead? N one said on dis manner, N another said on dat manner.
N there came forth a spirit, N stood before tha LORD, N said, I will persuade him.
N tha LORD said 2 him, Wherewith? N he said, I will go forth, N I will be a lyin spirit in tha mouth of all his prophets. N he said, u will persuade him, N prevail also: go forth, N do so.
Now therefore, look, tha LORD has put a lyin spirit in tha mouth of all dese ur prophets, N tha LORD has spoken evil concerning u.
But Zedekiah tha son of Chenaanah went near, N struck Micaiah on tha cheek, N said, Which way went tha Spirit of tha LORD from me 2 speak 2 u?
N Micaiah said, look, u will see in dat day, when u will go in2 an inner chamber 2 hide urself.
N tha king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, N carry him back 2 Amon tha governor of tha city, N 2 Joash tha king’s son;
N say, like dis says tha king, Put dis fellow in tha prison, N feed him wit bread of affliction N wit water of affliction, until I come in peace.
N Micaiah said, If u return at all in peace, tha LORD has not spoken by me. N he said, listen, O people, every one of u.
So tha king of Israel N Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah went up 2 Ramoth-gilead.
N tha king of Israel said 2 Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, N enter in2 tha battle; but put u on ur robes. N tha king of Israel disguised himself, N went in2 tha battle.
But tha king of Syria commanded his thirty N two captains dat had rule over his chariots, sayin, Fight neither wit small nor great, save only wit tha king of Israel.
N it happened, when tha captains of tha chariots saw Jehoshaphat, dat dey said, Surely it is tha king of Israel. N dey turned aside 2 fight against him: N Jehoshaphat cried out.
N it happened, when tha captains of tha chariots perceived dat it was not tha king of Israel, dat dey turned back from pursuing him.

N a certain man drew a bow at a venture, N struck tha king of Israel between tha joints of tha harness: so he said 2 tha driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, N carry me out of tha host; 4 I am wounded.
N tha battle increased dat day: N tha king was stayed up in his chariot against tha Syrians, N died at even: N tha blood ran out of tha wound in2 tha midst of tha chariot.
N there went a proclamation throughout tha host about tha goin down of tha sun, sayin, Every man 2 his city, N every man 2 his own country.
So tha king died, N was brought 2 Samaria; N dey buried tha king in Samaria.
N one washed tha chariot in tha pool of Samaria; N tha dogs licked up his blood; N dey washed his armour; according 2 tha word of tha LORD which he spoke.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Ahab, N all dat he did, N tha ivory house which he made, N all tha citiez dat he built, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Israel?
So Ahab slept wit his fathers; N Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
N Jehoshaphat tha son of Asa began 2 reign over Judah in tha fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Jehoshaphat was thirty N five years old when he began 2 reign; N he reigned twenty N five years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Azubah tha daughter of Shilhi.

N he walked in all tha ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doin dat which was right in tha eyes of tha LORD: nevertheless tha high places were not taken away; 4 tha people offered N burnt incense yet in tha high places.
N Jehoshaphat made peace wit tha king of Israel.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Jehoshaphat, N his might dat he showed, N how he warred, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
N tha remnant of tha sodomites, which remained in tha days of his father Asa, he took out of tha land.
There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish 2 go 2 Ophir 4 gold: but dey went not; 4 tha ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
Then said Ahaziah tha son of Ahab 2 Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go wit ur servants in tha ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
N Jehoshaphat slept wit his fathers, N was buried wit his fathers in tha city of David his father: N Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
Ahaziah tha son of Ahab began 2 reign over Israel in Samaria tha seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, N reigned two years over Israel.
N he did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N walked in tha way of his father, N in tha way of his mother, N in tha way of Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, who made Israel 2 sin:
4 he served Baal, N worshipped him, N provoked 2 anger tha LORD God of Israel, according 2 all dat his father had done.
